name: homeland-group
description: Homeland Group — React frontend + Node/Express API (MySQL). The API serves the built frontend, so this deploys as a single Node web service.

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix api install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix api install --no-audit --no-fund
